name: b6724-shadow
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, inside a dim mud-brick room, a small ordinary clay water jug stands on the floor beside an early Islamic clay slipper oil lamp; the low flame throws the jug's shadow huge, twisted and menacing up the rough plaster wall. No people. Mood: suspicion - an innocent thing made monstrous by how it is seen; unsettling, distorted. 7th-century Arabian setting: mud-brick walls, palm-trunk beams, plain clay vessels, palm-fibre mats. No faces, no hands, no blood, no moon, no text, no calligraphy, no modern objects, no glass, no metal locks or keyholes.
